title: Wheatfield Kitchen · Country kitchen in Malmesbury
text: Wheatfield Kitchen. Menu, For the children, Wine, Find us. Country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday, 12:00 to 15:00. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Book a table. Lunch Tuesday to Sunday. Dinner Thursday to Saturday. Sixty seats, on the stoep too. Wheelchair access. The menu: country cooking from the Swartland's own farms. The kitchen can leave out gluten or dairy on most dishes, if you ask when you book. Starters: snoek pâté, R85, with farm bread and apricot jam. Beetroot and feta salad, R80, roasted beetroot, rocket and walnuts. Soup of the day, R70, with farm bread. Mains: the Sunday roast, R165, on Sundays, with roast potatoes and gravy. Lamb shank, R185, slow-cooked, on mash. Chicken pie, R125, with a green salad. Bobotie, R140, with yellow rice and chutney. Vegetable bake, R115, vegetarian. Puddings: malva pudding, R65, with custard. Melktert, R55, with cinnamon. Ice cream, R45, with chocolate sauce. For the children: a children's menu, each dish R75: fish and chips, chicken strips and chips, macaroni cheese. Wine: wines from the Swartland and the Riebeek Valley, by the glass or the bottle. Corkage R60. Not drinking? Rooibos iced tea R35, and filter coffee R30. Find us: open Tuesday to Sunday, lunch 12:00 to 15:00, and dinner 18:00 to 21:30 from Thursday to Saturday. Closed Mondays. Sixty seats inside and on the stoep, wheelchair access, and parking behind the restaurant. Groups of more than twelve, and private functions, by arrangement with the owner.
